approval_at_head.description: reviewer bot ([bot] suffix normalized) APPROVED, submittedAt > newest non-merge commit

headings.description: each a line-anchored `## …` heading or `**…**` label, case-insensitive

upstream_line.description: `unchanged (<v>)` arms; anything else, or absent, parks

oneOf.description: handed off (major/awaiting-human added, agent/in-progress removed, re-read) OR armed (packaging-only chart major)
REFUSED — nothing written; the migration evidence is missing
UNREADABLE — a probe failed before any write
end state NOT PROVEN — writes issued, re-read does not show them
